rationale: Lorenzo's work on high-quality datasets and data annotation for embodied AI at Abaka AI directly complements Kaushik's hands-on robotics and autonomous systems expertise at Mytra. They can explore how Abaka's annotation and RLHF capabilities could accelerate the training data pipeline for Mytra's robotics applications, bridging the gap between data infrastructure and embodied AI systems.
intro_message: Lorenzo, meet Kaushik Prakash — he's a Senior ML Engineer at Mytra working on robotics and autonomous systems, and your expertise in AI data services for embodied AI could be valuable as he scales his ML infrastructure.
